content.text: In Zimbabwe, where conventional payment platforms are severely restricted, digital creators face a daunting [[LINK:https://[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-which-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-selling-music-online-accepting-bitcoin-4|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-actually-2|The COREMERCH]].github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-selling-music-online-accepting-bitcoin-2|infrastructure]] problem: how to automate digital product delivery after a crypto payment confirms without relying on a restrictive third-party platform. For those selling ebooks, courses, and software, the solution lies in a properly configured sovereign stack, which processes orders in under 30 seconds and empowers creators to own their infrastructure. By leveraging Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, digital creators can break free from platform limitations and build a resilient digital commerce ecosystem. This breakdown will explore the technical underpinnings of Google Apps Script for digital commerce automation, highlighting the key components and deployment strategies that make it work.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a cloud-based programming platform that enables developers to automate tasks and processes on the Google Cloud Platform. For digital commerce, it provides a robust backend infrastructure for automating order fulfillment, payment processing, and delivery of digital products. By integrating Google Apps Script with Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, creators can build a seamless digital commerce experience that is both efficient and scalable. This architecture is particularly valuable for creators operating in regions where conventional payment platforms are restricted, as it allows them to own their infrastructure and process orders quickly and securely.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture consists of several key components, each playing a critical role in automating digital product delivery. Cloudflare Workers handle incoming webhook events, which trigger the order fulfillment process. Google Apps Script then interacts with Supabase, a cloud-based database, to retrieve order information and update the status. Meanwhile, NOWPayments processes the crypto payment and sends a confirmation to the Cloudflare Workers, which in turn trigger the order fulfillment process. This seamless integration enables creators to automate the entire order-to-delivery process, ensuring a smooth and efficient experience for customers.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed for digital creators operating in regions with restricted payment platforms, such as Zimbabwe, Ghana, and Pakistan. By leveraging Google Apps Script, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments, these creators can build a resilient digital commerce ecosystem that is both efficient and scalable. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, is a comprehensive solution that enables creators to deploy a fully functional digital commerce platform in just 48 hours.
Cloudflare Workers handle 100,000 webhook events per day on the free tier, enabling high-volume order fulfillment.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Cloudflare Workers, Google Apps Script, Supabase, and NOWPayments are the key components that make this infrastructure work. Cloudflare Workers handle incoming webhook events, while Google Apps Script automates order fulfillment and interacts with Supabase. NOWPayments processes crypto payments and sends confirmations to Cloudflare Workers, which trigger the order fulfillment process. This seamless integration enables creators to automate the entire order-to-delivery process, ensuring a smooth and efficient experience for customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this infrastructure today, follow these concrete steps: first, set up a Cloudflare account and create a new Cloudflare Workers project; next, integrate Google Apps Script with Cloudflare Workers and Supabase; then, configure NOWPayments for crypto payment processing; finally, deploy the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) and test the entire infrastructure. By following these steps, creators can build a resilient digital commerce ecosystem that is both efficient and scalable.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

The webhook secret is the security mechanism that prevents fake webhook injection. NOWPayments signs every webhook with an HMAC hash using the secret key you configured in your account. Your backend recomputes the hash using the same secret key and the raw webhook body. If the hashes match, the webhook is legitimate. If they do not match, the request is rejected before any order processing occurs. This validation happens in under one millisecond. Combined with the independent on-chain transaction verification that follows, it creates a two-layer security model that makes fraudulent order injection effectively impossible against a correctly configured sovereign stack.

A webhook is an event-driven API that sends a notification to a Cloudflare Workers project when a crypto payment is confirmed. This triggers the order fulfillment process, which is automated by Google Apps Script and Supabase.
Can I automatically send download links after a crypto payment confirms?

Yes, by leveraging Google Apps Script and Supabase, creators can automatically send download links to customers after a crypto payment confirms. This seamless integration ensures a smooth and efficient experience for customers.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital product delivery with crypto payments works by leveraging Cloudflare Workers, Google Apps Script, Supabase, and NOWPayments. When a crypto payment is confirmed, a webhook notification is sent to the Cloudflare Workers project, triggering the order fulfillment process and automating delivery of digital products.

Cloudflare Workers handle incoming webhook events and trigger the order fulfillment process. They interact with Google Apps Script and Supabase to automate delivery of digital products and ensure a seamless experience for customers.
